body:
Right now the og image is kinda blogpost oriented -- but we also have this cover pictures. Can we update it? 

@Sepo-agent /answer

comments.body: I have a full picture. Here's my answer. --- Good idea — the covers are a much better social preview than the generated card. Here's what I found and how I'd wire it up. ## How OG images work today - The `CustomOgImages` emitter ([`quartz/plugins/emitters/ogImage.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/plugins/emitters/ogImage.tsx)) generates a `.webp` per page using the **blogpost-oriented** `defaultImage` template in [`quartz/util/og.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/util/og.tsx) (title + description + date + reading time + tags). - There's already an escape hatch: if a page has `socialImage` frontmatter, the emitter **skips generation and uses that image directly** (`ogImage.tsx` L120, L133, and the `externalResources` hook L149-155). [`Head.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/Head.tsx) defers to the same hook. - The frontmatter transformer coalesces `socialImage` / `image` / `cover` into `data.socialImage` ([`frontmatter.ts:101`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/plugins/transformers/frontmatter.ts#L101)). - Episodes already carry the cover as `coverImage: "/static/covers/EP06-cover.png"` (e.g. [`ep06.md`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/content/episodes/ep06.md)), and every `EPxx-cover.png` is a 1920×1080 (16:9) file in [`quartz/static/covers/`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/tree/main/quartz/static/covers) — good enough for OG (platforms crop toward 1200×630). **The gap:** `coverImage` isn't in the alias list, so covers are ignored and episodes fall back to the generated card. ## Two paths **Option A — use the raw cover as the OG image (recommended, minimal).** Make episodes' existing `coverImage` feed `socialImage`, so the cover is served directly: 1. Add `"coverImage"` to the alias list in `frontmatter.ts:101`. 2. Fix path handling for site-absolute values: the `externalResources` hook only handles absolute URLs or bare filenames — a value like `/static/covers/EP06-cover.png` would get double-prefixed to `.../static//static/...`. Add a branch so a leading-`/` path is used as-is. (`isAbsoluteURL` returns false for `/…` paths — [`path.ts:43`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/util/path.ts#L43).) 3. Verify a built episode page's `og:image` meta resolves to the cover and skips `.webp` generation. Result: episodes show the cover; all other pages keep the generated card. Zero per-episode edits. **Option B — composite the cover into a branded card.** Keep generating an image but pass a custom `imageStructure` that renders the cover as a full-bleed background with the logo/title overlaid (Satori supports `` via base64, same pattern as the `iconBase64` load in `ogImage.tsx:33-40`). More design work, but gives a consistent branded frame instead of the bare screenshot. ## My recommendation Go with **Option A** — it reuses the cover art you already ship and needs only two small code changes plus a build check. If you'd rather have a designed card (cover + logo + title) rather than the raw 16:9 image, say so and I'll scope Option B instead. Want me to proceed with Option A? A couple of things to confirm: - Should **only episodes** use covers, or also livestreams (there's an `LS01-cover.png`) and any other cover'd content? - Raw cover as-is, or does it need a title/logo overlay? --- `claude` | `claude-opus-4-8` | `high` | `GitHub Actions 1000005044`

title: Chang the og image for episode release
